verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's chat-completion docs cover 'grammars, constraints, and tools' through an OpenAI-compatible API, and strict schema adherence is documented for structured output. That shows first-party tool support, but only as a thin mention. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calls, multi-step/agent-loop tool use, evidence of tool-call reliability across open models and providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking

citations.quote: Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API.
If set to true, the model will always follow the exact schema defined in the `schema` field.
